title: Disappearance of Malaysia Airlines flight MH370
place_text: Kuala Lumpur / South China Sea / Indian Ocean

tellings.quote: On March 8th, 2014, Malaysia Airlines flight MH370 took off from Koala Lumpur with 239 people aboard.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels retells the story of Malaysia Airlines flight MH370, a passenger plane that he says took off from Kuala Lumpur, the capital of Malaysia, on March 8th, 2014, with 239 people aboard, and then vanished. He brings it up in an episode about why top American scientists are going missing, placing it among other unexplained disappearances.
